title: When Are Contrarian Profits Due to Stock Market Overreaction?
note: A contrarian payoff alone cannot identify overreaction. Cross-security lead–lag effects can also account for it. Treat reversal as a testable hypothesis and keep causal explanations tentative.

title: Trading Volume and Serial Correlation in Stock Returns
note: Aggregate volume can condition daily return autocorrelation in a liquidity-pressure model. A stock-level volume and return signal is a new hypothesis, with a scale and universe mismatch.

title: Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers
note: The paper studies strategies at multi-month horizons. A five-session feature predicting next-open relative returns is an extrapolation with a different horizon.

title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning
note: The paper compares models for predicting equity returns using stock characteristics. Its monthly empirical setting differs from the prototype's daily next-open holding period.
